host_edits.after:
local function buildings_build(apt, txt)
    local G = apt.geo
    local data = osm_parse(txt)
    if not data then
        local ok, decoded = pcall(json_decode, txt)
        if ok and type(decoded) == "table" and decoded.schema == "oans-dsf-buildings-v1" and type(decoded.buildings) == "table" then
            local elements = {}
            for i, building in ipairs(decoded.buildings) do
                local geometry = {}
                for _, point in ipairs(building.points or {}) do
                    if type(point) == "table" and tonumber(point[1]) and tonumber(point[2]) then
                        geometry[#geometry + 1] = { lon = tonumber(point[1]), lat = tonumber(point[2]) }
                    end
                end
                local tags = building.kind == "terminal" and { aeroway = "terminal" } or { building = "yes" }
                elements[#elements + 1] = { id = i, type = "way", tags = tags, geometry = geometry }
            end
            data = { elements = elements }
        end
    end
    if not data then
        return nil, "response not readable"
    end

local function draw_plane(px, py, th, col, k)
    k = k or 1
    local fx, fy = math.sin(th) * k, -math.cos(th) * k
    local rx, ry = math.cos(th) * k, math.sin(th) * k
    for pass = 1, 2 do
        local c, w = (pass == 1) and 0xFF000000 or col, ((pass == 1) and 7 or 4) * k
        DL.line(px + fx * 16, py + fy * 16, px - fx * 20, py - fy * 20, c, w)
        DL.line(px + fx * 3 - rx * 17, py + fy * 3 - ry * 17, px + fx * 3 + rx * 17, py + fy * 3 + ry * 17, c, w)
        DL.line(px - fx * 15 - rx * 7, py - fy * 15 - ry * 7, px - fx * 15 + rx * 7, py - fy * 15 + ry * 7, c, w)
    end
end
host_edits.after:
-- Angular aircraft cross: flat nose, square wingtips and narrow tailplane.
local function draw_plane(px, py, th, col, k)
    k = k or 1
    local fx, fy = math.sin(th) * k, -math.cos(th) * k
    local rx, ry = math.cos(th) * k, math.sin(th) * k
    local function bar(x0, y0, x1, y1, c)
        DL.quadf(px+rx*x0+fx*y0, py+ry*x0+fy*y0,
                 px+rx*x1+fx*y0, py+ry*x1+fy*y0,
                 px+rx*x1+fx*y1, py+ry*x1+fy*y1,
                 px+rx*x0+fx*y1, py+ry*x0+fy*y1, c)
    end
    for pass = 1, 2 do
        local c = (pass == 1) and 0xFF000000 or col
        local edge = (pass == 1) and 1.5 or 0
        bar(-1.5-edge, -20-edge, 1.5+edge, 16+edge, c)
        bar(-17-edge, 1.5-edge, 17+edge, 4.5+edge, c)
        bar(-6-edge, -16.5-edge, 6+edge, -13.5+edge, c)
    end
end

local function draw_building(b, col, lim)
        local cost = count_tris(b.tris)
        for _, ring in ipairs(b.contours or {}) do cost = cost + #ring.x * 8 end
        if DL.n + cost > lim then return false end
        if not draw_tris(b.tris, col, lim, true) then return false end
        -- AA only the outer and courtyard boundaries, never triangle diagonals
        -- or artificial bridges. Reuse the A350 line AA and viewport clipping.
        for _, ring in ipairs(b.contours or {}) do
            local px, py = XY(ring.x[#ring.x], ring.y[#ring.y])
            for k = 1, #ring.x do
                local qx, qy = XY(ring.x[k], ring.y[k])
                DL.line(px, py, qx, qy, col, 0.5)
                px, py = qx, qy
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    -- Linienzuege: sichtbare Stuecke in Bildschirmpunkte (Mindestabstand), bei Platzmangel staerker ausduennen
